default_account.description: Name of the default account to use if no --account flag is provided.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to 'off' to disable logging (not recommended for production).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'mail', 'daemon'). Leave blank to use file logging only.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS globally. If enabled, TLS is used for all accounts unless overridden per-account.

tls_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS (for port 587 or 25) or implicit TLS (for port 465). Set false only for insecure test environments.

tls_trust_file.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle file (PEM format) to verify the server certificate.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate (PEM) for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to client private key (PEM) for mutual TLS (optional, must match cert).

tls_nocertcheck.description: Skip server certificate verification (dangerous — only for internal testing).

accounts.description:
List of SMTP accounts (profiles). At least one account is required for real-world usage.
items.type=object
items.fields.name.type=string
items.fields.name.default=""
items.fields.name.description="Unique account identifier (e.g., 'gmail', 'smtp2')."
items.fields.host.type=string
items.fields.host.default=""
items.fields.host.description="SMTP server hostname or IP address (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com')."
items.fields.port.type=number
items.fields.port.default=587
items.fields.port.description="SMTP server port (typically 25, 465 (implicit TLS), or 587 (STARTTLS))."
items.fields.from_addr.type=string
items.fields.from_addr.default=""
items.fields.from_addr.description="Return address (envelope sender) used in emails sent via this account."
items.fields.auth_method.type=string
items.fields.auth_method.default=""
items.fields.auth_method.enum=["","login","plain","cram-md5"]
items.fields.auth_method.description="Authentication method. Leave blank for unauthenticated relay (not recommended for public servers)."
items.fields.user.type=string
items.fields.user.default=""
items.fields.user.description="SMTP username for authentication (if auth_method is set)."
items.fields.password.type=string
items.fields.password.default=""
items.fields.password.description="SMTP password for authentication (store securely — consider using a credentials helper)."
items.fields.tls.type=boolean
items.fields.tls.default=null
items.fields.tls.description="Override global TLS setting for this account (true/false). If omitted, uses global setting."
items.fields.tls_starttls.type=boolean
items.fields.tls_starttls.default=true
items.fields.tls_starttls.description="STARTTLS for this account (ignored if tls=false)."
items.fields.tls_trust_file.type=string
items.fields.tls_trust_file.default=""
items.fields.tls_trust_file.description="Per-account CA cert file (overrides global tls_trust_file)."
items.fields.tls_cert_file.type=string
items.fields.tls_cert_file.default=""
items.fields.tls_cert_file.description="Per-account client cert (overrides global)."
items.fields.tls_key_file.type=string
items.fields.tls_key_file.default=""
items.fields.tls_key_file.description="Per-account client key (overrides global)."
items.fields.tls_nocertcheck.type=boolean
items.fields.tls_nocertcheck.default=false
items.fields.tls_nocertcheck.description="Disable cert verification for this account only (dangerous — avoid in production)."
